a_defect_found_building_it.effect: the ledger hashed the JSON string while the stored hash was over the parsed dict, and reported a sound digest as missing_record - a false negative in an audit ledger, which is the worst direction for this kind of error
a_defect_found_building_it.family: Gate 151's DATE coercion - an untyped read diverging from the typed one
a_defect_found_building_it.fix: read the payload through the repository that owns it, so the two paths agree by construction rather than by coincidence
a_defect_found_building_it.what: a raw sa.text() read of a JSON column returns a str on SQLite; only the typed sa.Table path deserializes it

excluded_sources.why: award compliance evidence is a different subject from whether a digest was shown and an intention recorded; one ledger answering both would have summary counts that answer neither
document metadata, and no body is stored anywhere

overall_status_rule: the weakest entry, never an average

audit_event: an audit event records an action, not what a tenant saw
delivery_intent: an intent is a plan; nothing was sent and there is no delivery to attest
the intent stores counts, not the items the digest showed
digest_record: nothing records whether a tenant read this digest
an archived digest is still readable; archive is a state
